title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：review　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 review 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the writer ① wrote the review that no reader in the study would have counted, and he said the writing was the whole of the month. The ② review, meaning the comment itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a review, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ review in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ review at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A review, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the writer said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the review was the whole of the matter, meaning the judgement and not the comment. The ⑥ review, meaning the judgement and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; review, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a comment and a judgement. He said the judgement is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ review had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ review of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of counting; review, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ review I remember is the comment counted in the manuscript, which closed in 1971 and is still counted as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ review, my mother said in 1973, is the only comment that improves by being counted; every review, she said, is a judgement that has agreed to look like a comment. She said the judgement was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 评论；复习（指书斋里每一篇旁边的那一篇）
B. n. 评论；复习（指那篇评论本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：write the review 写这一篇评论
D. n. 评论；复习（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 评论之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的评论之事）
F. n. 评论；复习（指手稿里写到、被清点的那一篇）
G. n. 评论、评断（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 评断（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wrote the review that no reader in the study would have counted
The review, meaning the comment itself and not the page
the review at the far shelf
the review was the whole of the matter
the review had become a line in a manuscript
The review of the whole thing
A review, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: write the review 意为“写这一篇评论”，1964 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯清点的一篇评论做了一遍。
review 意为“评论；复习”，指那篇评论本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
review 意为“评论；复习”，指书斋里每一篇旁边的那一篇，每一篇旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
review 意为“评论；复习”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
review 意为“评论、评断”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这篇评断就是那件事的全部。
review 意为“评断”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那篇评论，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
review 意为“评论；复习”，指手稿里写到、被清点的那一篇，到 1969 年这一篇成了手稿里的一行。
review 意为“评论之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的评论之事是一处书斋和三个月份的清点。
review 意为“评论；复习”，我记得的是手稿里清点过的那一篇，1971 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一篇。
review 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，评论是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的评论。
